headline: Cloud surges 82%, still down from highs
chart_note: 52-week range: $235.84 - $408.61. Currently $332.60, about 19% below its February high despite record Cloud growth.
why_today: Q2 2026 revenue hit $119.8B, up 24% YoY, with Google Cloud revenue surging 82% to $24.8B on AI infrastructure demand. Net income jumped 298% to $112B. All 58 analysts covering the stock rate it a Buy, yet shares remain about 19% below their February high.
pro_1: Cloud growth accelerating fast (82% YoY) while the stock trades at just 16.7x earnings - cheap for this growth rate
pro_2: Unanimous Buy consensus (58/58 analysts), average price target of $428 implies roughly 29% upside
con_1: Heavy AI infrastructure spending could pressure margins if growth decelerates
con_2: Still hasn't reclaimed its February high, showing the market wants more proof before re-rating it
